scope: Four WT HBDH enzyme-substrate pairs with experimental ternary structures and reduction kinetics, plus four activity-only mutant/acetoacetate pairs with explicit WT modelling templates

references.si_status: Downloaded from official ACS Figshare; Methods and Tables S1-S4 verified directly
references.final_bundle_note: Include factual extraction and source URLs; do not bundle the NC-licensed SI PDF or the extracted full text.

records.family: SDR; 3-oxocarboxylate reductase, domain-extension relative to broad industrial KRED panels
records.variant: wild type; PDB reports no mutations
records.assay_construct_correspondence: Same WT enzyme described by the same group. 2020 methods state that PaHBDH and AbHBDH were expressed and purified as in the 2018 kinetic study. Deposited FASTA is the reference polymer sequence; purified assay proteins have the N-terminal processing documented separately below.
records.substrate_bound_role: Actual ketone substrate captured with oxidized cofactor
records.cofactor_caution: This is an experimentally determined enzyme:NAD+:ketone ternary complex. Do not rename NAD+ as NADH or present an NADH-replaced model as an experimental Michaelis complex.
records.assay_temperature_note: 2018 SI Tables S1-S4 print 283 K; the 2020 paper labels these experimental values as 10 degrees C. Preserve the original value and use 10 degrees C only as the nominal condition, without silently overwriting it.
records.assay_method: Initial rates from loss of NADH absorbance at 340, 370, or 380 nm; epsilon respectively 6220, 2320, or 1210 M^-1 cm^-1; 1 cm quartz cuvette, Shimadzu UV2600. SI does not map each temperature row to a specific wavelength.
records.assay_conditions_evidence: 2018 SI pp. S4-S5; temperature rows in Tables S1-S4, pp. S15-S16; 2020 Table 3 experimental footnote says 10 degrees C.
records.replicate_note: Original 2018 SI says at least duplicate measurements; table values are mean plus/minus fitting error. Do not claim biological replicates or a fixed number of quadruplicates from the later thesis.
records.kinetic_fit: One-substrate saturation curves at a saturating co-substrate concentration, fitted to Michaelis-Menten equation S1 by nonlinear regression in SigmaPlot 14
